text:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm going to open a small refresh PR for the 'Starter Stroll' hello-world quickstart. Goal: simplify auth section, remove the legacy inline API-key curl example, and add a minimal first-deploy checklist. I'll include a short migration note for teams on older SDKs.

Sam: Nice. Any breaking changes we should call out prominently?

Maya: Nothing breaking in behavior. Mostly copy edits + new recommended patterns. Will replace this pattern:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \```
with a tiny SDK-first snippet and a secure curl example that reads from env.

Ken: Can you also fix the broken link on the auth page? It currently points to /docs/auth-v2 which 404s. I ran into that in the onboarding workshop.

Maya: Good catch, Ken — I'll update the link to /docs/auth and add a redirect note in the PR description.

Tess: I can take screenshots for the deploy checklist and run the smoke flow in staging once the PR is up. Will also validate the sample app's Dockerfile (we had a stale base image last time). :white_check_mark: 

Maya: Awesome, thanks. PR will be #4123 — rough description: "starter-stroll: auth cleanup, deploy checklist, SDK snippet update".

DocsBot: lint/markdown-check failed on files/migration.md: trailing-whitespace. See CI job 987.

Maya: I'll fix the lint issues before requesting reviews.

Sam: Suggestion — keep an explicit short section called "first deploy checklist" with 3 bullets: env vars, port mapping, basic healthcheck. Minimal and copyable.

Maya: Yup that's the plan. Draft checklist in PR body for quick copy.

Tess: After PR is merged I'll run the onboarding lab and record any surprises. If the Docker base needs bumping I'll open a follow-up.

Ken: Also, there's an old example in the CLI guide that references `--api-key` flag; it should be replaced with `--token` per the new UX. I'll search-and-sweep once PR is open.

Maya: Thanks — feel free to push small edits directly to the branch. I'll tag @Sam and @Tess for review.

DeployBot: Staging deploy queued for branch maya/starter-stroll (build #2218).

Maya: Opening PR now. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — please skim when you get a sec. I'll add a migration note for SDK users and include one-liner commands for curl and SDK.

Sam: Quick nit — can we avoid code blocks > 6 lines in the quickstart? Keep it scannable.

Maya: Agreed. I'll keep snippets bite-sized and link to the full examples directory for advanced cases.

DocsBot: CI check passed on docs lint after fixes.

DeployBot: Staging deploy succeeded for branch maya/starter-stroll (build #2218).

Tess: Deployed to staging and walked through the checklist. One minor text tweak: the env var name should be REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN in the quickstart. I'll push the tiny change.

Maya: Solid. Thanks everyone — planning to merge tomorrow after a final sanity pass.

Ken: If you want, I can run a short smoke test script on merge to prod gate.

Maya: Please do. Adding the script link to the PR.

Sam: LGTM once Tess' var rename is in. :+1:

Maya: Merging tomorrow AM. Will post a short note to #announcements with the updated quickstart link and a sentence about the auth example change.

DocsBot: Reminder: don't forget to add the PR to the changelog under "docs".

Maya: Will do. Thanks all!
